elevate.move: Curate 7 approved carpenter-media images showing process (measure-mark-saw-chisel-dryfit-clamp-finish) matching filmstrip CUT 00-06 numbering. Apply single duotone grade using Harbor Teal + Clapboard Cream palette. Use object-position to put hand/tool on a third. Turns placeholder weakness into signature strength.

Drive estimator price reveal with same --sw-p clip-wipe as cut rules so selecting job type draws kerf line under output before number appears. Threads signature into tool making wow moment inseparable from concept: the price draws itself like a cut line.
